Definition: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
BiblicalUsage: Tsalach is prospering — and the Spirit rushing on a man. God told Joshua that if the law did not depart from his mouth, he would make his way prosperous; the psalmist says the man planted by the rivers of water prospers in all he does; and Joseph prospered because the LORD was with him. But the same word says the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon Saul, and upon Samson — God prospering His work by His Spirit coming with power.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prosperity in the Bible is never luck and never self-made — it is the LORD being with a person, and His Spirit coming on them. My position is that the way to prosper is the way Joshua was given: keep God's word in your mouth and do it. I hold that the same Spirit who rushed on Saul and Samson still empowers God's people today.
